column1: # Skim file-type association catalog consumed by installer_apply_associations.
# identifier is a UTI or a filename extension; failure ∈ report|ignore, where
# "ignore" is best-effort because Launch Services does not know every
# identifier on every macOS version. A "-" label falls back to the identifier.
# Applying this catalog is a run-once step, so editing a row changes what the
# next apply would set without setting it. DOTFILES_RESET=skim-associations dot
# Role "editor" throughout — never "all" — so that the viewer role registered
# by macOS Preview is not claimed unexpectedly.
